description: This file defines a custom exception class 'CustomerServiceException' within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It extends the base PHP Exception class and provides a static method to generate a specific exception message related to customer deletion constraints.

classes.name: CustomerServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to signal issues related to customer service operations within the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: CustomerExist
methods.description: A static method that returns an instance of CustomerServiceException with a message indicating that customers with logged time cannot be deleted.

calls: new self('Not Allowed to Delete Customer(s) Which Have Time Logged Against')
